ms.promise:
A. A functional chain-tracking engine capable of identifying on-chain transactions relevant to the selected dApp protocols.
B. Code-generation tooling that produces dApp-specific schemas from Tx3 protocol mappings and the integration code required to semantically enrich tracked transaction data for dashboards.
C. Integration of a backend data storage and querying solution set up for scalable data retention and extraction.
D. An example dApp protocol mapping and corresponding dataset to demonstrate the end-to-end tracking and enrichment pipeline.
ms.criteria:
A1. The chain-tracking engine identifies and stores on-chain transactions associated with the selected dApp protocols.
B1. The generated schemas and integration code produce stored transaction data that includes the metadata derived from the Tx3 protocol mappings. 
C1. The integrated data storage and querying layer provides efficient access to the stored data, consistent with the system design and aligned with the dashboard’s expected data..
D1. The example dApp protocol and its associated stored data can be used to demonstrate the full tracking, storage, and enrichment workflow.
